name: Kit 7 — Weekly GBP Auto-Poster (All Suburb Profiles)

nodes.name: Weekly Wednesday 9am Cron
nodes.notes: Posts to all active GBP profiles every Wednesday at 9am. Different content for each profile.

nodes.name: Load All Active GBP Profiles
nodes.notes: Loads all active GBP profiles from the sheet. Filters out suspended or inactive ones.

nodes.name: Load Business Config
nodes.notes: Loads business config for Claude context

nodes.name: Assign Post Angles (Rotating Weekly)
nodes.notes: Rotates through 6 post angles so each week feels different. Includes AU season context for seasonal relevance.

nodes.name: Split by GBP Profile
nodes.notes: Processes one GBP profile at a time to avoid API rate limits

nodes.name: Claude — Write Suburb GBP Post
nodes.notes: Writes a unique, suburb-specific GBP post for this week's angle. Every profile gets different content.

nodes.name: Publish Post to GBP
nodes.notes: Publishes the post to the suburb's GBP profile via Google My Business API

nodes.name: Log Post to Sheet
nodes.notes: Tracks all published posts for content calendar visibility

nodes.name: Last Profile in Batch?
nodes.notes: Only sends the summary WhatsApp once, after all profiles are posted

nodes.name: WhatsApp — Posts Published Summary
nodes.notes: Sends a single summary WhatsApp confirming all posts were published

meta.description: Posts unique, suburb-specific content to every active GBP profile every Wednesday. Rotates through 6 post angles (job spotlight, seasonal offer, local FAQ, community, behind-the-scenes, milestone). Each post mentions the suburb 3+ times and the target keyword 2+ times for maximum local rank signal.
